name: Lophelia Coral Bioherm #4
description: Centuries-old Lophelia pertusa cold-water skeletal reefs. Heavy hydrocarbon sedimentation threatens complete polyps asphyxiation.
countermeasure: Subsea deflection bubble curtains; 5 NM exclusion buffer for toxic chemical dispersants.

name: Herring Spawning Ground #12
description: Critical spring spawning clutches for North Sea herring stock. High embryonic cardiac deformity risk; $18.4M catch value at risk.
countermeasure: Issue emergency trawler exclusion notices and acoustic fish diversion deterrents.

name: Vestland Coastal Nature Reserve
description: Ramsar wetland sanctuary hosting 45,000 breeding pairs of Atlantic Puffin and Black-legged Kittiwake.
countermeasure: Pre-stage 2,400m coastal deflection booms across Outer Fedje and Florø entrances.

name: Sognefjord Outer Aquaculture Zone
description: Atlantic salmon smolt and harvest cages. Surface sheen ingestion causes acute gill necrosis and market condemnation.
countermeasure: Activate pneumatic bubble barricades and deep-skirt containment curtains at fjord bottleneck.
